verdicts.why: Strange Supreme is one of the Guardians of the Multiverse fighting Ultron, and with the Watcher he seals Killmonger and Zola away; he is an ally in this battle.
At New Asgard Zemo is part of Kamala's group (he points out Sokovia never had a queen) and is killed by the zombies with Jimmy Woo and Death Dealer.
In the Paris battle Rintrah, Valkyrie and Blade Knight die and Shang-Chi is infected; Peter is only threatened by the Wasp, and Katy and Scott are not shown dying.

Alex first destroys Cerebro; the mansion explosion comes from a second blast he fires at Apocalypse and the Horsemen, who teleport, so it hits the generator. Wikipedia: Alex 'attempts to stop them but causes an explosion'.
Kurt is at the mansion when it is destroyed and with Scott and Jean follows Stryker's forces to free the captives; fox-nightcrawler-young is the existing file.
Logan, Rogue, Iceman and Pyro escape the raid together; fox-pyro is the existing file and the out already names John.
Emma Frost sits on Genosha's council and is present at the massacre (the out already says she survives in diamond form); fox-anim-emma-frost exists.
Fury brings the Destroyer gun, which Coulson uses on the Centipede soldiers; the revived Garrett is vaporized with the Peruvian Tesseract weapon.
Coulson atomizes Garrett with the recovered Peruvian 0-8-4 at Cybertek and reclaims it there; object id 0-8-4 exists and its status line already says so.
In AKA The Octopus Costa says the dreams of holding his gun to his head stopped the day Jessica killed Kilgrave.
Lewis shoots Isaac Lange through his apartment door and uses his Anvil uniform to get into the hotel; the other Anvil employees die in the hotel attack.
'The Blip' names the event and period when half of life was gone, not the people who returned.
On screen the rival triad is the Hatchets / Hatchet Men; 'Yang Clan Company' is called a front for them, and Yangsi Gonshi is the wiki page title.

value.out: When Danny goes back with Colleen Wing to make amends, he finds dead Hand warriors at the mouth of the pass and the way to the city gone.
loss:0: The monks of K'un-Lun, killed by Elektra and the Hand.

verdicts.why: Wikipedia and the episode page both say the bodies at the gate are dead Hand operatives; the monks' killing is only told by Elektra in The Defenders, so by the later-reveal rule the loss moves there.
In Gods and Monsters Harrow himself kills Selim, Yatzil and the other avatars, then breaks the ushabti to free Ammit.
Ammit is not free when the avatars die; Harrow kills them, so the clause comes out of the outcome.
The Ennead's avatars are killed by Harrow before he releases Ammit.
Dar-Benn opens the Sun jump point with her single band and the Universal Weapon, knowing she still needs the second band; she only takes Kamala's band in the fight that follows.
